sentences.text: Krzyzanowskisaurus is a tooth taxon known only from fossils of teeth, including the holotype tooth NMMNH P-29357 — the specific specimen the species is based on.
The genus Krzyzanowskisaurus, meaning "Stan Krzyżanowski's lizard", was named after a person and is known from the Late Triassic Chinle Formation in the U.S. states of Arizona and New Mexico.
The original report described Krzyzanowskisaurus as a probable ornithischian dinosaur.

The name was changed from Revueltosaurus hunti to Krzyzanowskisaurus hunti because the type species of Revueltosaurus was found to be a pseudosuchian rather than an ornithischian dinosaur. Krzyzanowskisaurus is classified within the unranked order Archosauria and is tentatively classified within the unranked family Crurotarsi.
The Paleobiology Database lists the parent group of Krzyzanowskisaurus as Ornithischia.
Krzyzanowskisaurus lived from the Carnian to the Norian stages, approximately 237 to 205.7 million years ago.

Irmis et al. (2006) challenged the classification of Krzyzanowskisaurus as a new genus, noting that its cingulum differed from true early ornithischians and that associated skull bones and osteoderms matched Revueltosaurus.
